effectivePrice:
COALESCE((
    SELECT ROUND(GREATEST(0,
      CASE
        WHEN entry.kind = 'percentage'
          THEN "price"::numeric * (1 - LEAST(entry.amount, 100) / 100)
        ELSE "price"::numeric - entry.amount
      END
    ), 2)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        d.value->>'type' AS kind,
        CASE
          WHEN d.value->>'value' ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (d.value->>'value')::numeric
          ELSE 0
        END AS amount,
        d.value->>'startsAt' AS starts_at,
        d.value->>'endsAt' AS ends_at,
        d.ord AS ord
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE
        WHEN "discounts" IS NULL OR btrim("discounts") NOT LIKE '[%' THEN '[]'::jsonb
        ELSE "discounts"::jsonb
      END) WITH ORDINALITY AS d(value, ord)
    ) AS entry
    WHERE entry.amount > 0
      AND entry.kind IN ('percentage', 'fixed')
      AND (entry.starts_at IS NULL OR entry.starts_at <= to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'))
      AND (entry.ends_at IS NULL OR entry.ends_at > to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'))
    ORDER BY entry.ord
    LIMIT 1
  ), "price"::numeric)
ratingBucket: (SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.rating)) FROM teleport_product_reviews r WHERE r.product_id = teleport_products.id AND r.status = 'approved' AND r.rating IS NOT NULL)
onSale:
(CASE WHEN COALESCE((
    SELECT ROUND(GREATEST(0,
      CASE
        WHEN entry.kind = 'percentage'
          THEN "price"::numeric * (1 - LEAST(entry.amount, 100) / 100)
        ELSE "price"::numeric - entry.amount
      END
    ), 2)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        d.value->>'type' AS kind,
        CASE
          WHEN d.value->>'value' ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN (d.value->>'value')::numeric
          ELSE 0
        END AS amount,
        d.value->>'startsAt' AS starts_at,
        d.value->>'endsAt' AS ends_at,
        d.ord AS ord
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE
        WHEN "discounts" IS NULL OR btrim("discounts") NOT LIKE '[%' THEN '[]'::jsonb
        ELSE "discounts"::jsonb
      END) WITH ORDINALITY AS d(value, ord)
    ) AS entry
    WHERE entry.amount > 0
      AND entry.kind IN ('percentage', 'fixed')
      AND (entry.starts_at IS NULL OR entry.starts_at <= to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'))
      AND (entry.ends_at IS NULL OR entry.ends_at > to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'))
    ORDER BY entry.ord
    LIMIT 1
  ), "price"::numeric) < "price"::numeric THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END)
variantAxisExists:
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE
        WHEN "variant_options" IS NULL OR btrim("variant_options") NOT LIKE '[%' THEN '[]'::jsonb
        ELSE "variant_options"::jsonb
      END) AS ax, jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(ax->'values') = 'array' THEN ax->'values' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS v WHERE ax->>'key' = __KEY__ AND v->>'value' = ANY(__VALUES__::text[]))
